title: #inc-2276: pg-feeds leader on a degraded volume, controlled switchover

messages.text: INC-2276 declared by @hq. Sev2. FeedBuildLagHigh, pg-feeds slow. IC: @hq.
pg-feeds-0 (leader) is slow. iostat on the node shows ~900ms await on its volume, dmesg has I/O errors for the disk. want to move the leader off it
asked #ask-oncall "how do I fail over postgres?", it gave me the repmgr steps from postgres-failover.md v2. trying
`repmgr -f /etc/repmgr.conf standby switchover --siblings-follow --dry-run` on pg-feeds-1 -> `bash: repmgr: command not found`
no /etc/repmgr.conf either. are we not on repmgr??
ok. we're on patroni since june, runbook v3. #ask-oncall cited a page that doesn't exist any more. lost 4 min
`kubectl -n feeds exec -it pg-feeds-0 -c postgres -- patronictl switchover pg-feeds --leader pg-feeds-0 --candidate pg-feeds-1 --force`
pg-feeds-1 is Leader, TL 15. pg-feeds-0 replica, streaming. RECONNECT feeds done on all 3 pgbouncer pods
cordoned the node, ticket for the volume PLAT-4459. resolving
INC-2276 resolved by @hq. Duration 25m. Postmortem owner: @hq.

looked at why #ask-oncall said repmgr. v2 was deleted from the runbooks registry on 2026-06-18, but the nightly job only upserts what it reads, so v2's chunks never left the index. there is also a copy of v2 in wiki-export-2024/Postgres_Failover.md. fixing both, details in the postmortem
